# One element per line, in the words its header carries. The file each
# makes is tests/fixtures/elements/<id>.dat, written by
#   godot --headless --path . --script src/dev/element_files_probe.gd -- --write
# and checked against what the maker makes now by the same probe without
# --write. tests/test_elements.py measures them; tools/build_custom.py
# builds them through the mesh pipeline into pipeline.json.
#
# The three asked for by name:
family=brick across=7 deep=2 plates=3 studs=yes
family=brick across=5 deep=1 plates=1 studs=yes
family=slope across=3 deep=3 plates=2 run=2 studs=yes
